description: Deterministic anti-slop tools for agent harnesses. Every tool prints one JSON object on stdout and nothing else.

contract.output: stdout carries exactly one JSON object

exit_codes.0: ran; verdict positive (lint ran, rewrite accepted, hop intact)
exit_codes.1: ran; verdict negative (rewrite rejected, bits lost)

tools.name: lint_file
tools.description: Lint one markdown file. Auto-detects language; Cyrillic routes to the Russian linter.

tools.name: lint_text
tools.description: Lint a string passed on stdin. Same output shape as lint_file.

tools.name: validate_rewrite
tools.description: Score a rewrite against its original. Rejects when the score rises or when a number, underscore identifier, or URL disappeared. Does not generate rewrites.
tools.returns: verdict accept/reject, score delta, lost tokens

tools.name: transmit_check
tools.description: Fidelity check for one hop in the channel: which numbers, identifiers, URLs, named constraints, and ordering relations survived transmission.
tools.returns: per-check pass flags and the lists of missing bits
